LanguageData.FH_LostSpike_Paraspike.label: lost spike
LanguageData.FH_LostSpike_Paraspike.description: The paraspike has lost the core spike it needs to sustain itself. If it cannot recover, it will wither and die.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Fingerspike.label: fingerspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Fingerspike.description: After being parasitized by a fingerspike, the host grows a bony tentacle from the surface of its body.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Gutspike.label: gutspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Gutspike.description: The host is almost immune to food poisoning, and gains immunity to gut worms while purging existing infestations.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Paraspike.label: paraspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Paraspike.description: Reduces bleeding and grants immunity to wound infections. Offspring of a creature parasitized by a paraspike will inherit the parasite.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Puffspike.label: puffspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Puffspike.description: Completely protects against asthma and lung rot, curing those diseases in the host's lungs. The host moves faster and tolerates toxic environments better.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Shatterspike.label: shatterspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Shatterspike.description: The host grows a splintering bone-spike tentacle capable of firing bone shards at range.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Shieldspike.label: shieldspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Shieldspike.description: The host gains stronger armor and a shield claw.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Toughspike.label: toughspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Toughspike.description: The host grows two bony tentacles and gains improved global work speed.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Trispike.label: trispike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Trispike.description: The host can release two random small fleshbeasts.
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Whipspike.label: whipspike parasitism
LanguageData.FH_Parasitism_Whipspike.description: The host grows a fleshy whip tentacle capable of striking nearby enemies.
LanguageData.FH_Spike_Paraspike.label: paraspike's spike
LanguageData.FH_Spike_Paraspike.description: The paraspike's vital parasitic spike. It embeds in the host and continuously regulates flesh and blood.
